title: Exclusion Constraints (EXCLUDE)
description: Prevent scheduling overlaps and spatial collisions at the database layer using GiST-backed exclusion constraints.

data.text: A **UNIQUE constraint** only checks for equality (`=`). But what if you need to guarantee that no two hotel bookings overlap in time (`&&`) or no two meeting room reservations collide? PostgreSQL's **`EXCLUDE` constraint** generalizes uniqueness across arbitrary operators using GiST indexes.

data.title: Preventing Room Booking Conflicts with EXCLUDE USING gist
data.content: Ensures no single room can have overlapping booking periods.

data.title: Eliminates Application-Level Race Conditions
data.text: Without exclusion constraints, preventing scheduling double-bookings requires complex distributed locks or serialized transactions. Exclusion constraints guarantee 100% collision prevention directly inside PostgreSQL.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: `EXCLUDE` enforces non-overlapping conditions across arbitrary operators.
Requires a GiST index and often the `btree_gist` extension.
The definitive database-level solution for calendar scheduling and booking systems.
